description: Searches the public asksteps website and returns the matching passages with their URLs. Use it to quote or cite what the product actually does instead of describing it from memory, and to check whether a feature exists at all. An empty result means no page mentions the term — treat that as 'probably not a feature', not as 'search failed'; the note field says which of the two it is.

locale.description: Preferred language of the page version, as an ISO 639-1 code such as "de" or "en". Pages that exist only in German are still returned.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "PDF signature", "webhook", "custom domain".

name: asksteps_search_docs

hits.description: Matching passages, best match first. May be empty.

locale.description: Language of this page version, as an ISO 639-1 code.

passage.description: The passage that matched, as plain text.

url.description: URL of the page — absolute when this deployment knows its public base URL, otherwise a site-relative path. Cite it when you use the passage; never invent the domain part yourself.

note.description: Set when the result needs explanation, e.g. when the documentation index is unavailable. Empty otherwise.

query.description: The query that was searched for.

title: asksteps: search the public documentation
